notes: Semicircular sign of riveted brass strip letters over a green door, Old City of Acre, seen from below. The Hebrew runs along the arc; the first word at the lower right (probably בית, giving 'בית הספרים הבפטיסטי') is not clearly legible and is left out. The Arabic line in the middle (decorative, beginning المكتبة, probably 'المكتبة المعمدانية' Baptist Library) is not transcribed because the letter strips are ambiguous. Photographer's 'PZ' mark at bottom left. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.
